what_changed.section_iv_b: Rewritten to the actual implementation: two stages. Stage 0 (initialization) = one-step physical prediction loss L_1 (new eq:loss_one_step) over the encoder-generated latent distribution, yielding a time-invariant base (A_0,B). Stage 1 (rollout-aware scheduled training) = minimize L_R (Def. rollout_aware, eq:loss_rollout) where the latent is propagated through A(c) and the context is re-scheduled from the predictor's own rolled-out history; jointly train theta, phi, A_0, U, V, g; B and C fixed; H_R=20.
what_changed.removed: Deleted the old-route EDMD three-stage pipeline: eq:edmd_solution (Stage 0 EDMD warm start, Stage 2 closed-form refit), the five losses (eq:loss_x, eq:loss_z, eq:loss_c, eq:loss_multi_x, eq:loss_multi_z, eq:pretraining_loss), the fixed-A multi-step rollout (eq:multi_step_lifted_rollout, eq:multi_step_state_rollout). Verified no dangling labels remain.
what_changed.algorithm_1: Rewritten: Output = (theta*, phi*, A_0*, U*, V*, g*); Stage 0 one-step init loop; Stage 1 scheduled-rollout loop re-scheduling the context from the rolled-out history.
what_changed.fig2_caption: Now 'One-step lifting and prediction (initialization, Stage~0)'; describes (A_0,B) one-step and the one-step loss, and states Stage 1 replaces A_0 by A(c).
what_changed.fig1_caption: Fixed-A dynamics zhat_{k+1}=A z_k+B u_k -> zhat_{k+1}=A(c_k) z_k+B u_k, for consistency with Definition 1.
what_changed.external_ref: The single external reference to eq:loss_x in Section IV-C was repointed to eq:loss_one_step.
